stages.name: Raw reads
stages.detail: Six first-million paired prefixes. All 12 uncompressed hashes match the supplied prior pilot.

stages.name: Trimming
stages.detail: nf-core/rnaseq with alignment and pseudoalignment disabled. All quality and adapter summary checks passed.

stages.name: SPLASH
stages.detail: Full-depth read1 SPLASH job 49214375 completed; all 5,538,699 adjusted P < 0.05 anchors are selected for extension in 554 batches, job 49221554. Separately, extension of all 213,658 significant prefix anchors completed: 165,679 anchors extended into 354,316 records; 47,979 without extensions. The sequence explorer remains the historical 300-anchor pilot.

stages.name: DE-kupl
stages.detail: Full-depth job 49203559 completed with exit0 in 3:05:46. Biological interpretation and a reference-free comparison are pending.

stages.name: Sourmash
stages.detail: Eight public untrimmed runs have validated indexes. The older six-library prefix HP index timed out and its searches were cancelled; all22 corrected public search batches completed and passed the independent pair-set/hash audit49241571.

stages.name: Bivalve archive
stages.detail: One trimmed public run passed independent four-alphabet paired-scale and self-search checks. The explicit threshold0 correction passed the complete public-pilot audit. Restored-access validation49241803 passed all four encodings and both scales with exact loss-set and self-search checks. Replacement932-worker array49241661 is eligible for scheduler allocation. 181 runs lack ENA FASTQ URLs.
